signals.signal: Bank's own branch/ATM locator API (AEM maps.viewport.json behind raiffeisenbank.rs/sr/stanovnistvo/lokacije.html) returns, as at 30/07/2026, 517 published places at 317 physical locations: 415 self-service devices and 102 branches, across 99 cities. Device subType breakdown: 240 'Visenamenski uredjaj' (multifunctional), 125 'Obican bankomat' (plain ATM), 50 'KUAN'. By published function: 204 devices do RSD+EUR deposit AND withdrawal (recycler class), 35 do RSD deposit+withdrawal, 125 are cash-out only, 51 are deposit-only ('Uplata dinara'); all 364 card-operated units accept contactless cards.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka a.d. Beograd - branch/ATM locator API (maps.viewport.json)
signals.implies: First hard, primary, machine-verifiable fleet count for RBRS, and it demolishes the carried figure: 240 multifunctional devices versus the '41 multifunctional ATMs on x-core' the Printec case page used to claim - roughly 6x - and 204 of them are dual-currency (RSD+EUR) deposit AND withdrawal, i.e. recycler-class. The 125 remaining cash-out-only ATMs are the addressable upgrade/replacement pool for Printec cash recyclers, plus x-core/omni-channel ATM software, ATM operations management and managed services.
signals.likelihood: High that fleet refresh/expansion decisions arise inside 6-12 months given 125 legacy cash-out units and stated 2025 expansion
signals.followup: Snapshot this JSON endpoint monthly to track device-mix drift; ask Printec Serbia whether the 240 multifunctional units actually run x-core and who supplies the hardware.

signals.signal: Same locator API: 102 branches across 47 cities. Branch service tags - 36 branches flagged 'Bezgotovinska filijala' (cashless branch), 97 branches host a 'Visenamenski uredjaj' (multifunctional device), 53 have a teller till only until 13:00, only 13 have a full-day teller, 6 are tagged 'Cash HUB', 34 have a 'Kuan uredjaj za uplatu pazara' and 14 a 'Livix uredjaj za uplatu pazara' (merchant daily-takings deposit machines), 6 offer safe-deposit boxes.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka a.d. Beograd - branch/ATM locator API (maps.viewport.json)
signals.implies: The 'Bank Yourself' branch-transformation model is live and now measurable: 35% of branches are already fully cashless and 95% of branches have a multifunctional device inside. Only 13 of 102 branches still run a full-day cash till, so the remaining 53 half-day tills are the near-term conversion pipeline for Printec teller cash recyclers (TCR), branch cash automation and in-branch self-service. The 6 'Cash HUB' sites imply a hub-and-spoke cash model that maps onto Printec cash-cycle managed services.
signals.likelihood: High - branch cash-desk conversion is an explicitly stated ongoing programme
signals.followup: Build the target list of the 53 half-day-till branches for TCR; establish what a 'Cash HUB' is operationally at RBRS and who equips it.

signals.signal: Annual Report 2025 (published on raiffeisenbank.rs), Branch Office Network chapter: 'Special attention was given to the continued digital transformation of the physical network. The expansion and enhancement of multifunctional devices and cash deposit machines available 24/7 allowed for more efficient daily transactions and reduced operational workload in branches.' Key-figures table: 2,084 employees and 102 branches at 31/12/2025 (2024: 2,049 employees / 103 branches); total assets RSD 774,123,699 thousand; profit after tax RSD 29,059,422 thousand.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka a.d. Beograd - Annual Report 2025 (AR_2025_Final.pdf)
signals.implies: The bank states in its audited annual report that it EXPANDED the multifunctional-device and cash-deposit-machine estate during 2025 in order to take load off branch counters. That is an explicit, board-level commitment to deposit automation and self-service - the exact demand Printec ATM/self-service, cash automation/recyclers and managed services address - and it is being done while branch count and cash tills shrink.
signals.followup: Ask for the 2025 device-count delta (how many units were added) and the 2026 capex envelope for self-service.

signals.signal: Annual Report 2025: in the Premium segment 97% of ALL cash transactions are performed via multifunctional devices; 93% of Premium clients communicate with the bank remotely and 92% of sales are remote; 98% of dinar payment transactions, 87% of international payments and 99% of FX transactions run through the app; mobile-engaged-customer ratio 84%; Premium client base +13.2% y/y.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka a.d. Beograd - Annual Report 2025 (AR_2025_Final.pdf)
signals.implies: 97% cash-transaction migration to self-service in the most profitable retail segment is the strongest published proof anywhere in the Serbian market that the self-service channel is now the primary cash channel, not an overflow channel. Availability, uptime and cash-in/cash-out balancing therefore become revenue-critical - which is the commercial argument for Printec ATM operations-management software, monitoring and managed services on top of hardware.
signals.followup: Pitch availability/SLA-based managed services against the 97% figure; find who currently does first/second-line maintenance on the fleet.

signals.entity: Raiffeisen banka a.d. Beograd (corporate cash deposit)
signals.signal: Corporate 'Uplata pazara na visenamenskim uredjajima' page: merchant daily-takings deposit is available at 65 locations in 26 cities, and higher-value deposit machines at 15 locations in 5 cities (Belgrade, Novi Sad, Kragujevac, Pozarevac, Smederevska Palanka). Limits differ by device type - dual-currency device: RSD 150,000 max daily and per transaction, 90 notes per transaction, denominations RSD 500 and above; dinar-only device: RSD 3,500,000 max daily, RSD 600,000 per transaction, 295 notes per transaction, denominations RSD 100 and above. No card is needed (the 9-digit tax number PIB is entered instead), every deposit is posted immediately, and the fee is RSD 60 per transaction versus RSD 75-2,000 at the counter. Day/night safes operate at four Belgrade locations.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka a.d. Beograd - 'Uplata pazara na visenamenskim uredjajima' (corporate)
signals.implies: The bank has priced counter cash out of the market (RSD 60 vs up to RSD 2,000) and only 15 sites can take a RSD 3.5m/295-note merchant deposit - a clear capacity gap in a country where retail cash is still heavy. That is a directly quantifiable expansion case for Printec high-capacity cash-deposit/recycling machines and merchant cash-automation, plus the CIT/cash-cycle managed service around them.
signals.likelihood: High - 65 of 102+ locations covered, expansion explicitly under way
signals.followup: Model the uncovered branch/merchant footprint (102 branches vs 65 uplata-pazara locations) as the sizing basis for a proposal.

signals.entity: Masterwork Automodules (KUAN) and Vivex Group (Livix) at Raiffeisen banka Serbia
signals.signal: Raiffeisen's locator names the actual merchant cash-deposit hardware in the account: 50 standalone devices carry subType 'KUAN' and 34 branches carry a 'Kuan uredjaj za uplatu pazara'; 14 branches carry a 'Livix uredjaj za uplatu pazara'. KUAN is the cash deposit system of Masterwork Automodules Tech Corp. (Taiwan) - a compact freestanding lobby machine, 10.1-inch touchscreen, Windows 10, 1,000 notes/minute, models KUAN Lite 10K / KUAN 10K / KUAN Coin & Note. Livix is the intelligent banknote deposit system / smart safe of Vivex Group (Belgrade), stated on the vendor site to be certified by the National Bank of Serbia and the European Central Bank, 20 notes/second (1,200/minute), up to 12,000 notes in security bags, Grade IV safe with four-eyes principle and two Class B electronic locks, Windows 10 / Livix 7 Cloud software.
signals.source_name: Masterwork Automodules - KUAN Cash Deposit System; Vivex Group - Smart Safes Livix; Raiffeisen locator API
signals.implies: Closes part of the standing 'name the incumbent' task: two cash-automation competitors are identified inside a Printec target account, and neither is a global ATM OEM. The split (48 KUAN sites + 14 Livix) shows there is NO single locked-in supplier for merchant cash deposit at RBRS, so a Printec cash-automation/recycler and smart-safe proposal is a live displacement play rather than a greenfield pitch. Vivex is also a local Serbian competitor to watch across the whole market.
signals.followup: Get contract terms/renewal dates for KUAN and Livix at RBRS; check whether Vivex/Automodules are also placed at Banca Intesa, OTP, NLB Komercijalna and AikBank.

signals.signal: Statement on receiving the Euromoney Awards for Excellence 'Best Retail Bank Serbia 2026' in London: Jelena Aksic (Management Board member for retail, small business and entrepreneurs) says that over the last five years clients have opened more than 300,000 iRacun accounts - a completely free current account ready to use in 15 minutes - and that the award motivates the bank to keep moving 'in the direction of digitalisation and automation while at the same time keeping outstanding service in branches'. CEO Zoran Petrovic frames innovation as an existential competitiveness question.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka - 'Euromoney: Raiffeisen je najbolja banka za stanovnistvo u Srbiji'
signals.implies: iRacun has moved from the carried >250k to >300,000 cumulative openings, and the stated strategy is explicitly 'digitalisation AND automation' with branches retained - i.e. self-service-heavy branches, not branch closure. The 15-minute remote opening runs on video identification plus electronic signature, a scaling eKYC volume that Printec digital onboarding/eKYC and identity-based digital services can extend (document verification, liveness, remote signing, AML screening at onboarding).
signals.likelihood: High - stated strategic direction with an active acquisition campaign behind it
signals.followup: Identify the incumbent video-identification and e-signature vendor behind iRacun onboarding.

signals.signal: iRacun acquisition campaign published 05/06/2026 and running to 31/07/2026: RSD 3,000 for opening a free iRacun plus RSD 5,000 for transferring salary, bonus to be activated by 30/09/2026. The account can be opened fully online in about 15 minutes using video identification plus an electronic signature via a code sent to the mobile phone, requires a valid ID card or passport, a camera-equipped device and a domestically registered phone number, and comes with digital Visa and DinaCard debit cards usable immediately in Moja mBanka plus two plastic cards posted to the customer.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka - 'Raiffeisen specijalna ponuda: 3.000 dinara uz otvoren iRacun i 5.000 za prenos zarade'
signals.implies: Cash-incentivised digital acquisition at scale drives onboarding throughput, instant digital card issuance and fraud/AML screening load up together - all addressable by Printec digital onboarding/eKYC, card-issuance infrastructure, AML/compliance and real-time transaction monitoring. Incentivised account opening is also a classic mule-account and application-fraud vector, which strengthens the transaction-monitoring pitch.
signals.likelihood: In force now; the acquisition window closes 31/07/2026
signals.followup: Track whether the campaign is renewed in Q4-2026 and what incremental account volume it produced.

signals.signal: Annual Report 2025, Corporate Banking chapter: 'Through digital KYC and electronic signatures via iPortal, we simplified additional account openings and KYC periodic reviews (36% of active clients completed KYC digitally, with FULL ONBOARDING DIGITIZATION PLANNED FOR Q1 2026).' The same chapter reports nearly 90% of confirmations generated automatically through digital channels, 85% of loan and guarantee drawdown requests submitted online, 64% of FX transactions executed automatically, and iPortal used by 56% of active corporate clients in 2025.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka a.d. Beograd - Annual Report 2025 (AR_2025_Final.pdf)
signals.implies: A dated, board-published commitment: FULL corporate onboarding digitisation targeted for Q1-2026, off a base of only 36% digital KYC completion. That is a concrete, in-window eKYC/digital-onboarding and AML/compliance workstream at a top-3 Serbian bank - Printec's digital onboarding/eKYC and compliance suite map onto it directly, including corporate UBO checks and periodic KYC refresh automation.
signals.likelihood: High - target date already reached, so status is verifiable now
signals.followup: Verify whether full corporate onboarding digitisation actually went live in Q1-2026 and who built it; if it slipped, that is an open opportunity.

signals.signal: Annual Report 2025: 'The year 2025 saw Raiffeisen banka establishing a complete AI operating model (organization, data, technology, use cases, education), paving the way for scale and agentic AI in 2026 and beyond.' Named corporate AI tools include Credit Bureau Conversion, a Corporate AI Assistant and a KYC Translator. The REA chatbot has been rebuilt on a large language model with advanced entity recognition and context switching and is being positioned as an AI copilot inside the mobile app, the end-to-end digital products (iKes, iAccount) and contact-centre interactions.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka a.d. Beograd - Annual Report 2025 (AR_2025_Final.pdf)
signals.implies: A funded, organisation-wide AI programme with 2026 as the scale year. The named use cases are already compliance-adjacent (KYC Translator, Credit Bureau Conversion), so this is the moment to position Printec AML/compliance and real-time transaction-monitoring/fraud-prevention as AI-enabled rather than rules-only - and to attach self-service analytics (cash forecasting, device uptime prediction) to the same budget.
signals.likelihood: High - 2026 is the stated scale year
signals.followup: Find out which AI platform/partner RBRS standardised on and whether financial-crime detection is in the 2026 use-case backlog.

signals.signal: Annual Report 2025: 'Since the Serbian banking system joined SEPA, we have initiated a local SEPA project in collaboration with our headquarters, which has extensive experience implementing SEPA with 12 banks across four countries. Our objective is to become a fully SEPA-compliant bank by May 4, 2026.' The bank's customer-facing SEPA Q&A confirms that from 05/05/2026 Serbian citizens and businesses can use the same payment conditions as other SEPA users, covering SCT, SCT Inst (instant EUR payments in up to 10 seconds) and SDD Core/B2B, and notes Bosnia and Herzegovina is announced as a new SEPA country from 2027.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka - 'SEPA - pitanja i odgovori o jedinstvenom podrucju placanja u evrima' and Annual Report 2025
signals.implies: Serbia's SEPA entry on 05/05/2026 is a market-wide payments re-platforming event: EUR instant credit transfer at 10-second SLA changes sanctions-screening and fraud-detection latency requirements for every Serbian bank. That is squarely Printec's real-time payment fraud prevention, real-time transaction monitoring and compliance-suite territory, and it opens the same conversation at every other Serbian bank simultaneously.
signals.likelihood: High - already in force since 05/05/2026, SDD and SCT Inst rollouts continue
signals.followup: Build a Serbia-wide SEPA-instant screening/fraud play; check which schemes RBRS is live on versus planned.

signals.signal: Global Finance 'The Innovators 2026 - Top Financial Innovations' regional award, one of ten CEE banks recognised, for 'Web kredit' - embedded buy-now-pay-later consumer lending in Serbia's largest online shops, now extended into physical stores as a hybrid flow that stays entirely on the customer's phone with on-the-spot assistance. Chief Innovation Officer Aleksandar Smiljkovic states the product keeps full regulatory compliance 'through automation, digital identification and electronic signing'.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka - 'Web kredit - Global Finance nagrada za bankarsku inovaciju'
signals.implies: Confirms an in-production, regulator-compliant digital identification + e-signature + automated decisioning stack that is now being pushed into merchant and point-of-sale contexts. That is a POS/acquiring and eKYC adjacency for Printec - embedded finance at the terminal, merchant onboarding, and transaction monitoring over BNPL flows, which carry elevated first-party fraud risk.
signals.likelihood: High - live and expanding to in-store
signals.followup: Check whether Web kredit in-store needs any terminal-side integration at merchant POS, which would be a direct Printec attach point.

signals.signal: Awarded the special 'Digital Banking Leader' recognition within the PC Press Top 50 selection (50 winners in 14 categories plus six special recognitions) for achievement in digitalising banking services. The bank singles out iPortal, a corporate-client portal it describes as unique in several respects on the domestic market, consolidating key processes and information for corporate clients in one place; the award was received by Management Board member for corporate banking Tanja Glisin.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen banka - 'Raiffeisen banka dobitnik specijalnog priznanja PC Press Top 50 Digital Banking Leader'
signals.implies: Corporate-side digital investment (iPortal) is a named and board-sponsored 2026 priority. Corporate cash management is exactly where Printec cash automation, merchant daily-takings deposit devices and POS monitoring/merchant portal products attach - and RBRS already exposes 'uplata pazara' machines as a corporate service, so the integration story writes itself.
signals.followup: Identify the iPortal build partner and whether cash/deposit device reporting is exposed inside it.

That page can't be found'). Treat x-core incumbency at RBRS as UNQUANTIFIED: the bank now runs 240 multifunctional devices and whether any or all run x-core is unproven externally. Given the estate grew ~6x versus the carried figure, either the incumbency grew with it (large installed base to defend and upsell) or a competitor took the growth (large displacement target). Resolving which is the single highest-value next action on this account.
signals.followup: Operator: complete the gated form at offer.printecgroup.com/raiffeisen-bank-case-study to retrieve the full case study. Internally: confirm current x-core licence scope and hardware vendor with Printec Serbia.

signals.signal: Re-verification and retirement of the carried '1m active-client target 2026'. The 1-million active-client mark was already reported as PASSED on completion of the merger with RBA banka a.d. Novi Sad (the former Credit Agricole Srbija, acquired April 2022), announced with 139 locations, over 300 ATMs, market share raised to 12%, a loan book above EUR 3bn and deposits above EUR 4.5bn. The merger completed operationally in 2023. Annual Report 2025 reports total customer numbers up 5.4% year on year, deposit market share 11.5%, corporate credit market share 10.2%, payments 15.5% domestic volume share (No.3) and 22.1% international volume share (No.2), FX 23% volume share (No.1).
signals.source_name: AmCham Serbia - 'Raiffeisen banka a.d. Beograd uspesno spojena sa RBA Bankom a.d. Novi Sad'; Raiffeisen AR 2025
signals.implies: The '1m active-client target 2026' should be RETIRED from the baseline - it was a 2023 post-merger achievement, not a forward target. More usefully, comparing the 2023 announcement to the 2026 locator shows the shape of the strategy: branches down from 139 locations to 102 (-27%) while self-service devices are up from 300+ to 415 (+38%). That branch-to-device substitution, running at roughly 4 devices per branch, is precisely the Printec self-service and cash-automation thesis and should anchor the account plan.
signals.followup: Retire the 1m target from the baseline; carry the 102-branch / 415-device pair instead.

signals.entity: National Bank of Serbia (market context for RBRS)
signals.signal: NBS payment statistics for Q1-2026, published 11/06/2026: 3,336 ATMs in Serbia, up 3.6% year on year; over 188,000 POS terminals, up 10.3%; 13.3 million payment cards issued (+8%, i.e. +991,000 versus Q1-2025) held by 7.1 million users; 208.6 million card purchases in the quarter, +18.7% year on year (195.2m on domestic cards, 13.4m on foreign cards). For comparison NBS reported 3,197 ATMs at end-September 2025 (-0.4% y/y) and 3,218 at end-2024 (+4.5% on 3,080 at end-2023).
signals.source_name: National Bank of Serbia payment statistics, reported by Tanjug
signals.implies: The Serbian ATM estate has turned back to growth after a flat/declining 2025 - from 3,197 in Sep-2025 to 3,336 in Mar-2026, roughly +139 units in two quarters - while POS grows about 10% and card purchases about 19%. Raiffeisen's 415 devices are about 12.4% of the national estate, in line with its market share. A growing national fleet plus deposit-automation migration is the demand backdrop for Printec ATM/self-service, recyclers, POS and managed services in Serbia.
signals.likelihood: High - quarterly series, next release expected around Sep-2026
signals.followup: Pull the release directly from nbs.rs (JS-rendered; use the /sr/scripts/showcontent/index.html?id= URLs) and get the per-bank ATM/POS split if published.

signals.entity: National Bank of Serbia IPS instant payments (market context)
signals.signal: The NBS IPS instant payment system processed 31.9 million instant payments in Q1-2026, up 30.8% year on year and 2.6x the level of five years earlier, with a value of RSD 392.8 billion, up 33.3% year on year. Over 10 million payments were made in Q1-2026 by scanning the NBS IPS QR code, worth over RSD 53 billion, +9% versus the previous quarter. Payment institution VIP SISTEM d.o.o. Belgrade joined IPS NBS on 05/06/2026.
signals.source_name: National Bank of Serbia IPS statistics, reported by Tanjug
signals.implies: Instant account-to-account payments and IPS QR are growing far faster than cards, and RBRS already exposes IPS QR bill payment on its multifunctional devices. Rapid A2A growth raises real-time fraud exposure (no chargeback, irrevocable settlement) - the commercial trigger for Printec real-time payment fraud prevention and transaction monitoring - while IPS QR acceptance is a POS/merchant-side attach point.
signals.followup: Get the exact NBS release date and the primary nbs.rs URL for this Q1-2026 IPS data (the Tanjug piece carries no visible date in the fetched text).

coverage_notes: Fresh full run (no checkpoint existed for 2026-07-30). Angles used, deliberately varied from prior runs: (1) the bank's own AEM branch/ATM locator JSON API, discovered by reading the Vue component attributes in the page HTML - this is the single most productive new source and yields a complete typed device inventory; (2) the full XML sitemap of raiffeisenbank.rs, which surfaced pages the open web does not rank (cashless-branch, uplata-pazara, visenamenski-bankomati, the /sr/common/izvestaji.html reports index, and every 2026 news item); (3) the audited Annual Report 2025 PDF extracted locally with pdfminer; (4) the corporate cash-deposit product page with its per-device limit table; (5) 2026 bank news releases in Serbian; (6) vendor-side primary sources for the two device brands named in the locator (Automodules for KUAN, Vivex Group for Livix); (7) NBS payment and IPS statistics for market context. Searched in English and Serbian. Genuine gaps: the AR 2025 does not publish an ATM/device count anywhere, so the locator is the only fleet source; the ATM/self-service HARDWARE OEM at Raiffeisen Serbia remains unidentified (KUAN and Livix cover only the merchant-deposit niche, not the 240 multifunctional units or the 125 cash-out ATMs); no procurement/tender register exists for Serbian private banks, so no tender signals could be produced; the Pillar-3 'Podaci i informacije o Banci 31.12.2025' PDF was downloaded but not mined, as the key-figures table in the AR already supplied headcount and branch count; RBI Group segment reporting was not opened this run.
access_issues: www.printecgroup.com/raiffeisen-serbia-branch-transformation/ returns HTTP 404 even with a desktop User-Agent - logged, and the surviving Printec asset at offer.printecgroup.com was used instead (that one 403'd on the first WebFetch and served on retry). nbs.rs statistics pages (/sr/drugi-nivo-navigacije/statistika/platni_sistem/ and /sr/finansijske-institucije/banke/platne-kartice/) are JS-rendered and return only CSS/font links to curl with a desktop UA, so NBS figures are cited via Tanjug and via the nbs.rs showcontent article URLs that do render - logged rather than dropped. www.raiffeisenbank.rs/sr/o-nama.html and /sr/o-nama/investitori/finansijski-izvestaji.html are 404; the live reports index is /sr/common/izvestaji.html. The AR 2025 PDF could not be text-extracted by pdfminer's one-shot high_level call within the tool timeout and had to be run as a background job. No source was silently dropped.
operator_requests: 1) Complete the lead-generation form at https://offer.printecgroup.com/raiffeisen-bank-case-study to download the full Raiffeisen Bank Serbia case-study PDF - it is expected to contain device counts, go-live dates and the hardware vendor, which would settle the x-core incumbency question. 2) If an operator has a browser session, open https://www.nbs.rs/sr/ciljevi-i-funkcije/platni-sistem/statistika/ and export the per-bank ATM/POS breakdown if one is published there, since the page does not render to a headless fetch.
